name: Jira - FE tickets to #fe-scan
description: Posts every Jira ticket tagged FE (label FE or frontend, or Component FE) to Slack #fe-scan, on creation or when the tag is added later. Created inactive.

parameters.content:
## Jira FE tickets to #fe-scan

Fires on jira:issue_created and jira:issue_updated across every Jira project, pre-filtered by the webhook JQL: labels in ("FE","frontend") OR component = "FE".

The Code node re-checks the tags and keeps the last 1000 posted issue keys in workflow static data, so each ticket is announced once - whether FE was there at creation or added later.

nodes.name: Fetch Recent FE and Localization Tickets

options.jql: (labels in ("FE", "frontend", "Localization", "needs_localization") OR component = "FE") AND updated >= -20m ORDER BY created DESC

main.node: Fetch Recent FE and Localization Tickets

activeVersion.name: Revert seeding, resume normal posting
activeVersion.description: Reverted the temporary seed-only pass. Back to the 20-minute updated window, normal per-ticket Slack posting, Slack node re-enabled. The 128 pre-existing tickets seeded into static data will never post, so the channel only carries tickets tagged from now on.
